policy.fallback: Render the full nickname when any approval is absent, pending, revoked, or invalid.
policy.publicationBasisNote: Owner-authorized public-profile portrait is a scoped directory-owner publication decision and must not be represented as individual consent.
policy.certificatePublicationBasisNote: Filled certificate images use the separate owner_authorized_public_certificate gate. QR targets are excluded from public data and contribution evidence.
policy.socialPreviewPublicationBasisNote: The social-preview photograph uses a separate owner_authorized_social_preview_image decision and is not approved for profile, brand, favicon, certificate, or other roles.
policy.heroPublicationBasisNote: Hero photographs, the historical static decorative derivative, the immutable Motif Release 1.2.1 runtime/source assets, and the Landom-page quiet-gray fallback derivatives have separate, role-scoped owner approvals. None is approved as a person portrait, favicon, certificate, or substitute navigation identity.

designSystem.conformanceBoundary: The owner-directed photo parallax is an explicit site-level divergence. Because Landometer Design System 0.9.1 accepts no exception references, this page does not claim zero-exception v0.9.1 conformance; all other documented DS rules are applied.

motifRelease.selectionScope: All six animated Landometer surfaces select the quiet records from motif release 1.2.1. The canonical runtime and source SVG bytes remain unchanged; this Landom page applies the separately recorded owner-approved quiet-gray presentation override and uses color-only derived fallback SVGs.
motifRelease.identityBoundary: logo-quiet is an animated hero brand-opening only; the official navigation logo remains static and authoritative.

artifactLocalReplay.scope: explicit Landom page-controller loop/replay only; not a portable Design System default

artifactLocalContrastOverride.scope: Landom page only; this is not a recolor of canonical motif release 1.2.1 and is not a portable Landometer Design System rule.
artifactLocalContrastOverride.runtimeBoundary: The pinned motif CSS and JavaScript remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Landom host CSS changes currentColor only.
artifactLocalContrastOverride.fallbackBoundary: Active fallbacks are site-local color-only derivatives of the pinned canonical quiet SVG sources, not exact motif-release fallbacks.
artifactLocalContrastOverride.transform: Replace #59D2FE with the applicable gray and change no other SVG byte.
artifactLocalContrastOverride.contrastQualification: The Hero rings layer retains its deliberately low host opacity, so this record does not claim that every translucent decorative segment reaches a 3:1 contrast ratio.

motifRelease.lifecycle: Start only after the motif is at least 14% visible; pause while hidden or offscreen; settle to the final SVG state after one finite run. Reduced-motion, no-JavaScript, runtime failure, print, and pause states keep the matching owner-approved quiet-gray derived final-state fallback visible.
